facts.fact: The central civil-status database, holding 20 million digitised and indexed acts in the national civil-status register, is reachable from the NEKKAL application deployed in 400 civil-status centres, on the word of the national civil-status agency's director-general on 5 November 2025.
facts.system: réseau des centres d'état civil connectés à l'application NEKKAL

facts.fact: NEKKAL was deployed in 400 civil-status centres with access to the central database at 5 November 2025, on the ANEC director-general's word; the count is of civil-status centres, which mayors run, not of communes, and no total is given.
facts.system: réseau des centres d'état civil connectés à l'application NEKKAL

facts.fact: The network of connected civil-status centres is run by the Agence nationale de l'état civil (ANEC), attached to the ministry of urbanism, local authorities and territorial planning, whose director-general on 5 November 2025 called NEKKAL the only tool the government recognises and told mayors using other software to stop.
facts.system: réseau des centres d'état civil connectés à l'application NEKKAL

facts.fact: The APS report of 5 November 2025 on the connected civil-status centres names no budget or funder.
facts.system: réseau des centres d'état civil connectés à l'application NEKKAL
